socraticHint: n bahut hi chhota hai (<= 12). Kya tum saari possible permutations generate karke brute force try kar sakte ho?
tleExplanation: n=12 pe 12! ≈ 4.79 * 10^8 operations hote hain. 12 se bada n TLE dega.

techniques: Subsets, Bitmask DP, Recursion with Backtracking
socraticHint: n <= 25 hai. Kya har element ke paas 'pick or skip' (2 choices) ka option hai? Subsets ya Bitmask DP socho.
n <= 500 hai. Kya teen nested loops chal sakte hain? (500^3 ≈ 1.25 * 10^8 ops - borderline par chal jata hai).
tleExplanation: 500^3 = 1.25 * 10^8 ops. Agar loop ke andar heavy operations hain to optimize karna padega.

socraticHint: n <= 5,000 hai. Saare pairs check karna O(n^2) me feasible hai (5000^2 = 2.5 * 10^7 ops < 10^8).
tleExplanation: 5,000^2 = 2.5 * 10^7 ops. Yeh 1 second limit (~10^8) ke andar aasaani se chal jayega.

bigO: O(n^2) borderline (~10^8) ya safer O(n log n) / O(n)
socraticHint: n ≈ 20,000 hai. n^2 = 4 * 10^8 ops jo TLE de sakta hai! Kya tum O(n log n) ya O(n) me bottleneck break kar sakte ho?
tleExplanation: 20,000^2 = 4 * 10^8 ops. LeetCode ki ~10^8 limit cross ho sakti hai, isliye O(n^2) risky hai.

techniques: Sorting, Heap / PriorityQueue, Binary Search, Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Prefix Sum
socraticHint: n ≈ 10^5 hai. O(n^2) seedha TLE dega (10^10 ops!). Target complexity O(n log n) ya O(n) honi chahiye. Kaunsa data structure repetitive work hatayega?
tleExplanation: 10^5 pe n^2 = 10^10 ops (Guaranteed TLE). n log2(n) ≈ 1.7 * 10^6 ops (Super fast, < 0.05 sec).

techniques: Single Pass, HashMap / HashSet, Sliding Window, Prefix Sum, Kadane
socraticHint: n bahut bada hai (10^6 ya 10^7). Sirf single pass O(n) chalega. Kya har element ko ek hi baar visit karke answer maintain ho sakta hai?
tleExplanation: 10^7 pe O(n log n) bhi borderline ho jata hai. Sirf simple O(n) pass hi safe hai.

techniques: Binary Search, Math Formula, Bit Manipulation
socraticHint: n >= 10^9 hai ya array access nahi hai. Array iterate karna impossible hai! Kya binary search on answer ya koi direct mathematical formula lag sakta hai?
tleExplanation: n = 10^9 iterate karne me 10+ seconds lagenge. O(log n) me sirf ~30 iterations lagenge.
